p: be 动词 am / is / are
use: I 用 am，第三人称单数（he / she / it / 单数名词）用 is，you 和复数用 are；否定直接加 not，疑问把 be 提到句首。
eg: I am a student, and my sister is a nurse.
我是学生，我姐姐是护士。
Are your parents at home now?
你父母现在在家吗？
These apples are not very sweet.
这些苹果不太甜。
q: My brother and I （ ） in the same class.

p: 一般现在时 第三人称单数 -s
m: 经常性动作、习惯、客观事实
use: 主语是第三人称单数时，动词加 -s / -es（have → has）；否定和疑问借助 does / doesn't，后面动词用原形。
eg: My father goes to work by subway every day.
我爸爸每天坐地铁上班。
She doesn't like coffee, but she drinks a lot of tea.
她不喜欢咖啡，但茶喝得很多。
Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
水在 100 摄氏度沸腾。
q: Tom usually （ ） his homework after dinner.

p: 现在进行时 be doing
use: am / is / are + 动词 -ing，表示说话时正在进行的动作，常和 now、look、listen 连用。
eg: Look! The children are playing in the snow.
看！孩子们正在雪地里玩。
I'm cooking dinner now. Can I call you back?
我正在做晚饭，我待会儿给你回电话行吗？
What is your mother doing?
你妈妈在做什么？
q: Listen! Someone （ ） the piano next door.

p: 一般过去时 did
m: 过去发生的动作或状态
use: 动词用过去式（规则动词加 -ed，不规则动词如 go → went 需要记忆）；否定和疑问用 didn't / did + 动词原形。常与 yesterday、last week、ago 连用。
eg: We went to the beach last summer.
我们去年夏天去了海边。
I didn't see him at the party yesterday.
昨天在聚会上我没看见他。
When did you start learning English?
你是什么时候开始学英语的？
q: She （ ） a new bike two days ago.

p: 一般将来时 will / be going to
use: will + 动词原形多表示临时决定或预测；be going to + 动词原形多表示事先的打算或有迹象的推测。
eg: It's cold in here. I'll close the window.
这里好冷，我去把窗户关上。
We're going to visit our grandparents this weekend.
这个周末我们打算去看爷爷奶奶。
Look at those dark clouds. It's going to rain.
看那些乌云，要下雨了。
q: — Have you bought the tickets? — Not yet. I （ ） them this afternoon.

p: There be 句型
use: There is / There are + 名词 + 地点，be 动词的单复数跟最靠近它的名词保持一致（就近原则）。
eg: There is a bookstore near my school.
我学校附近有一家书店。
There are thirty students in our class.
我们班有三十个学生。
There is a pen and two notebooks on the desk.
书桌上有一支笔和两个笔记本。
q: There （ ） some milk in the fridge.

p: many / much / a lot of
use: many 修饰可数名词复数，much 修饰不可数名词（多用于否定句和疑问句），a lot of / lots of 两者都可以修饰，多用于肯定句。
eg: How many brothers do you have?
你有几个兄弟？
I don't have much time today.
我今天没有多少时间。
She has a lot of friends in this city.
她在这座城市有很多朋友。
q: How （ ） money do you need for the trip?

p: some / any
use: some 多用于肯定句，any 多用于否定句和疑问句；但表示请求或希望得到肯定回答的疑问句（如 Would you like…?）用 some。
eg: I bought some bread this morning.
我今天早上买了些面包。
Do you have any questions?
你们有什么问题吗？
Would you like some tea?
你要来点茶吗？
q: Sorry, there isn't （ ） juice left. Would you like water instead?

p: 冠词 a / an / the
use: a / an 表示泛指“一个”，an 用在元音音素开头的词前（an hour, a university）；the 表示特指或双方都知道的事物，也用于独一无二的事物（the sun）。
eg: I saw an old man and a dog in the park.
我在公园里看见一位老人和一条狗。
The dog was very friendly.
那条狗非常友好。
It takes about an hour to get there.
到那里大约需要一个小时。
q: My cousin studies at （ ） university in Beijing.

p: 比较级 -er / more … than
use: 单音节和部分双音节形容词加 -er，多音节词前加 more；比较对象用 than 引出。可以用 much、a little、even 修饰比较级。
eg: My room is bigger than yours.
我的房间比你的大。
This question is more difficult than the last one.
这道题比上一道难。
She runs much faster than her brother.
她跑得比她哥哥快得多。
q: The weather today is much （ ） than yesterday.

p: 最高级 the -est / the most
use: 三者或三者以上比较时用最高级，形容词最高级前一般加 the，范围用 in（某地/群体内）或 of（同类之中）。
eg: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
珠穆朗玛峰是世界上最高的山。
This is the most interesting book I've ever read.
这是我读过的最有意思的书。
Lucy is the youngest of the three sisters.
露西是三姐妹中最小的。
q: Of all the subjects, I think math is （ ）.

p: 情态动词 can / could
use: can + 动词原形表示能力或许可，过去式 could 表示过去的能力；Could you…? 比 Can you…? 更礼貌。
eg: My grandmother can speak three languages.
我奶奶会说三种语言。
I couldn't swim when I was five.
我五岁时还不会游泳。
Could you help me carry this box?
你能帮我搬一下这个箱子吗？
q: When he was young, he （ ） run very fast.

p: must / have to
use: must 多表示说话人主观认为必须，have to 表示客观情况迫使；mustn't 表示“禁止”，don't have to 表示“不必”。
eg: You must wear a seat belt in the car.
坐车必须系安全带。
I have to get up early tomorrow because I have an exam.
明天我得早起，因为要考试。
You don't have to come if you're busy.
你忙的话就不必来了。
q: — Must I finish it today? — No, you （ ）. You can finish it tomorrow.

p: should 表示建议
use: should + 动词原形表示建议或义务，否定 shouldn't 表示“不应该”；口语里常用 You should… 给别人提建议。
eg: You should drink more water when you have a cold.
感冒的时候你应该多喝水。
We shouldn't play games for too long.
我们不应该玩太久游戏。
Should I bring anything to the party?
我需要带点什么去聚会吗？
q: You look tired. You （ ） go to bed earlier.

p: 现在完成时 have done（经历、完成）
use: have / has + 过去分词，表示过去的动作对现在的影响或到现在为止的经历；常与 already、yet、ever、never、just 连用，不能和 yesterday 等明确的过去时间连用。
eg: I have already finished my homework.
我已经写完作业了。
Have you ever been to Shanghai?
你去过上海吗？
She has never tried Indian food.
她从来没吃过印度菜。
q: — Is Lisa here? — No, she （ ） to the library.

p: 现在完成时 + for / since
use: 现在完成时表示持续到现在的状态，for + 一段时间，since + 过去的时间点；持续时，瞬间动词要换成延续性表达（buy → have，die → be dead）。
eg: I have lived in this city for ten years.
我在这座城市住了十年了。
We have known each other since primary school.
我们从小学起就认识了。
How long have you had this phone?
这部手机你用了多久了？

p: 被动语态 be done
use: be + 过去分词，动作的执行者用 by 引出（不重要时可省略）；时态通过 be 的变化来体现，如 is made、was built、will be held。
eg: English is spoken in many countries.
很多国家都说英语。
This bridge was built in 1990.
这座桥建于 1990 年。
The meeting will be held next Monday.
会议将在下周一举行。

p: 宾语从句 that / if / whether
use: 陈述句作宾语用 that（口语中常省略）；一般疑问句作宾语用 if / whether，表示“是否”。从句用陈述语序，主句是过去时，从句时态一般要相应变化。
eg: I think that he is right.
我觉得他是对的。
She asked me if I could help her.
她问我能不能帮她。
I'm not sure whether he will come.
我不确定他会不会来。
q: I don't know （ ） she likes the gift.

p: 定语从句 who / which / that
use: 修饰人用 who / that，修饰物用 which / that，放在被修饰的名词后面；关系代词在从句中作宾语时可以省略。
eg: The girl who is singing is my classmate.
正在唱歌的那个女孩是我同学。
This is the movie that I told you about.
这就是我跟你说过的那部电影。
I lost the umbrella which my mother gave me.
我把妈妈给我的那把伞弄丢了。
q: The man （ ） lives next door is a doctor.

p: 时间状语从句 when / while
use: when 后可接短暂或延续性动作，while 后多接延续性动作，常与进行时连用；表示将来时，从句用一般现在时代替一般将来时。
eg: When I got home, my mom was cooking.
我到家的时候，妈妈正在做饭。
While I was reading, the phone rang.
我正看书时，电话响了。
I'll call you when I arrive in Beijing.
我到北京后给你打电话。
q: Please tell him the news when he （ ） back.

p: 条件句 if（真实条件）
use: 表示可能实现的条件：If + 一般现在时，主句用 will / can / must + 动词原形（“主将从现”）。
eg: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。
If you study hard, you can pass the exam.
如果你努力学习，就能通过考试。
What will you do if you miss the last bus?
如果错过了末班车你怎么办？
q: If you （ ） this button, the machine will start.

p: 动词 + to do（不定式）
use: want、hope、decide、plan、agree、learn、would like 等动词后接 to + 动词原形；否定形式是 not to do。
eg: I want to be a teacher in the future.
我将来想当老师。
They decided not to go out because of the rain.
因为下雨，他们决定不出去了。
Would you like to join us for dinner?
你愿意和我们一起吃晚饭吗？
q: My parents agreed （ ） me a new computer.

p: 动词 + doing（动名词）
use: enjoy、finish、mind、keep、practice、give up 以及介词后面接动名词（动词 -ing 形式）。
eg: I enjoy listening to music before bed.
我喜欢睡前听音乐。
Would you mind opening the door?
你介意开一下门吗？
He is good at drawing.
他擅长画画。
q: Have you finished （ ） the report yet?

p: too … to / … enough to
use: too + 形容词 + to do 表示否定意义；形容词 + enough + to do 表示“足够……可以”，注意 enough 放在形容词后面。
eg: The box is too heavy for me to carry.
这个箱子太重了，我搬不动。
He is old enough to take care of himself.
他已经大到能照顾自己了。
It's too late to change your mind now.
现在改主意已经太晚了。
q: The boy isn't （ ） to ride a motorbike.

p: so … that / such … that
use: so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句；such + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + that 从句。
eg: I was so tired that I fell asleep on the sofa.
我累得在沙发上睡着了。
It was such a nice day that we went for a picnic.
天气那么好，我们就去野餐了。
She spoke so fast that nobody could follow her.
她说得太快，谁都跟不上。
q: It was （ ） interesting book that I read it twice.

p: 感叹句 What … ! / How … !
use: What + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 (+ 主语 + 谓语)！；How + 形容词/副词 (+ 主语 + 谓语)！
eg: What a beautiful garden!
多漂亮的花园啊！
How fast he runs!
他跑得真快！
What delicious food you made!
你做的饭真好吃！

p: 反义疑问句
use: 前肯后否、前否后肯，后半部分的助动词和代词要和前半句一致；回答时按事实，事实肯定用 Yes，事实否定用 No。
eg: You are from Shanghai, aren't you?
你是上海人，对吧？
She didn't go to school yesterday, did she?
她昨天没去上学，是吧？
Let's go for a walk, shall we?
我们去散散步吧，好吗？

p: used to do
use: used to + 动词原形表示过去的习惯或状态，暗含“现在已经不这样”；否定 didn't use to，疑问 Did you use to…?
eg: I used to walk to school when I was a child.
我小时候常常走路上学。
There used to be a cinema on this street.
这条街上以前有一家电影院。
Did you use to play the piano?
你以前弹钢琴吗？
q: My grandfather （ ） smoke, but he quit ten years ago.

p: 过去进行时 was / were doing
use: was / were + 动词 -ing，表示过去某一时刻或某段时间正在进行的动作；常与 when 引导的一般过去时从句搭配，表示“正在……时，突然……”。
eg: At eight last night, I was watching TV.
昨晚八点我正在看电视。
We were having dinner when the lights went out.
我们正在吃晚饭，灯突然灭了。
What were you doing at this time yesterday?
昨天这个时候你在做什么？
q: — I called you at 9 last night, but no one answered. — Sorry, I （ ） a shower.

p: 间接疑问句
use: 把特殊疑问句放进 Can you tell me… / I wonder… / Do you know… 等句子里时，要用陈述语序（疑问词 + 主语 + 谓语）。
eg: Could you tell me where the nearest station is?
请问最近的车站在哪里？
Do you know what time the shop closes?
你知道那家店几点关门吗？
I wonder why she left so early.
我想知道她为什么走得那么早。
q: Excuse me, can you tell me （ ）?
how I can get to the museum
how can I get to the museum
how do I can get to the museum

p: 过去完成时 had done
use: had + 过去分词，表示在过去某一时间或动作之前已经完成的动作，即“过去的过去”；常与 by the time、before、when 连用。
eg: When we arrived at the cinema, the film had already started.
我们到电影院时，电影已经开始了。
She had never seen snow before she moved to Harbin.
搬到哈尔滨之前，她从没见过雪。
By the end of last year, they had planted over 500 trees.
到去年年底，他们已经种了 500 多棵树。
q: By the time the police arrived, the thief （ ）.

p: 将来进行时 will be doing
use: will be + 动词 -ing，表示将来某一时刻正在进行的动作，也可以委婉地询问对方的安排。
eg: This time tomorrow, I will be flying to London.
明天这个时候我正在飞往伦敦的途中。
Don't call me at eight; I'll be having a meeting.
八点别给我打电话，那时我在开会。
Will you be using the car tonight?
你今晚要用车吗？
q: Don't phone me between 2 and 4 tomorrow afternoon. I （ ） an exam then.

p: 现在完成进行时 have been doing
use: have / has been + 动词 -ing，强调从过去开始一直持续到现在、可能还要继续的动作，常带有感情色彩。
eg: I have been waiting for you for an hour.
我已经等了你一个小时了。
It has been raining since last night.
从昨晚起一直在下雨。
Your eyes are red. Have you been crying?
你眼睛红红的，哭过了吗？
q: She is exhausted because she （ ） on the project all day.

p: 将来完成时 will have done
use: will have + 过去分词，表示到将来某一时间为止将会完成的动作，常与 by + 将来时间、by the time 连用。
eg: By next June, I will have graduated from college.
到明年六月，我就大学毕业了。
The new subway line will have been completed by 2028.
新地铁线将在 2028 年前建成。
By the time you get here, we will have finished dinner.
等你到这里，我们已经吃完晚饭了。
q: By the end of this month, we （ ） this English course.

p: 进行时 / 完成时的被动语态
use: 进行时被动：am / is / are / was / were being + 过去分词；完成时被动：have / has / had been + 过去分词。
eg: The road is being repaired, so we have to take another route.
路正在维修，所以我们得绕路。
All the tickets have been sold out.
所有的票都已经卖完了。
The house had been cleaned before the guests arrived.
客人到之前房子已经打扫干净了。
q: A new library （ ） in our town at present.

p: must / may / can't have done（对过去的推测）
m: 一定 / 可能 / 不可能（已经）……
use: 情态动词 + have done 表示对过去情况的推测：must have done 肯定推测，may / might have done 可能，can't / couldn't have done 否定推测。
eg: The ground is wet. It must have rained last night.
地是湿的，昨晚一定下雨了。
He may have missed the train.
他可能错过了火车。
She can't have said that; she's too polite.
她不可能说那种话，她那么有礼貌。
q: Jack （ ） the meeting yesterday; I saw him in Shanghai at that time.

p: should have done / needn't have done
m: 本应该……（却没有）；本不必……（却做了）
use: should have done 表示过去该做而没做，带有责备或后悔；shouldn't have done 表示不该做却做了；needn't have done 表示本不必做却做了。
eg: You should have told me earlier.
你本该早点告诉我的。
I shouldn't have eaten so much.
我不该吃那么多的。
You needn't have brought a gift, but thank you!
你其实不用带礼物的，不过谢谢你！
q: I failed the test. I （ ） harder.

p: 虚拟语气 if I were …（与现在事实相反）
m: 要是……就好了 / 如果……就会……
use: If + 主语 + 过去式（be 一律用 were），主句用 would / could / might + 动词原形，表示与现在事实相反或不太可能实现的假设。
eg: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
如果我是你，我会接受这份工作。
If I had more time, I could travel around the world.
如果我有更多时间，我就能环游世界了。
What would you do if you won the lottery?
如果你中了彩票，你会做什么？
q: If I （ ） his phone number, I would call him right now.

p: 虚拟语气 if I had done（与过去事实相反）
use: If + 主语 + had + 过去分词，主句用 would / could / might + have + 过去分词，表示与过去事实相反的假设，常带遗憾语气。
eg: If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the flight.
要是我早点出发，就不会误机了。
If she had asked for help, we would have helped her.
她当时要是开口求助，我们肯定会帮她。
We could have won if we had played better.
要是我们发挥得好一些，本来是能赢的。
q: If you had followed my advice, you （ ） into trouble.

p: wish + 虚拟
use: wish 后的从句用虚拟：与现在相反用过去式（be 用 were），与过去相反用 had done，对将来的愿望用 would / could + 动词原形。
eg: I wish I could speak French.
我真希望我会说法语。
She wishes she hadn't sold her old guitar.
她后悔把那把旧吉他卖掉了。
I wish it would stop raining.
真希望雨能停下来。
q: I wish I （ ） to the concert last night. Everyone says it was amazing.

p: 非限制性定语从句 , which / , who
use: 用逗号与主句隔开，对先行词或整个主句补充说明；不能用 that，关系代词也不能省略。which 可以指代前面整句话的内容。
eg: My sister, who lives in Canada, is coming home next week.
我姐姐住在加拿大，她下周回家。
He passed the driving test on his first try, which surprised everyone.
他第一次就通过了驾照考试，这让大家都很吃惊。
The Great Wall, which is over 2,000 years old, attracts millions of visitors.
长城有两千多年历史，吸引了数百万游客。
q: She didn't reply to my message, （ ） made me a little worried.

p: 介词 + 关系代词 in which / with whom
use: 当关系代词在从句中作介词宾语时，可以把介词提到关系代词前面，此时只能用 which（指物）或 whom（指人），不能用 that。
eg: This is the house in which Lu Xun once lived.
这就是鲁迅曾经住过的房子。
The colleague with whom I share an office is very quiet.
和我同一个办公室的同事很安静。
I don't like the way in which he talks to his parents.
我不喜欢他跟父母说话的方式。
q: The pen （ ） he wrote the letter was a gift from his father.

p: 关系副词 where / when / why
use: 先行词是地点、时间、原因，且在从句中作状语时，分别用 where、when、why（相当于介词 + which）；先行词在从句中作主语或宾语时仍用 which / that。
eg: I still remember the day when we first met.
我还记得我们第一次见面的那天。
This is the café where I usually study.
这就是我平时学习的那家咖啡馆。
That's the reason why I changed my job.
这就是我换工作的原因。
q: We visited the factory （ ） my father worked twenty years ago.

p: what 引导的名词性从句
use: what 相当于 the thing(s) that，在从句中作主语或宾语，整个从句可以充当句子的主语、宾语、表语。注意和 that 区分：that 在从句中不充当成分。
eg: What you said really helped me.
你说的话真的帮了我。
I can't believe what I'm seeing.
我简直不敢相信自己看到的。
This is exactly what I wanted.
这正是我想要的。
q: （ ） surprised me most was his calm attitude.

p: 同位语从句 the fact / news / idea that …
m: ……这一事实 / 消息 / 想法
use: that 从句放在 fact、news、idea、belief、hope 等抽象名词后，说明该名词的具体内容；that 不作成分且不能省略。
eg: The news that our team had won spread quickly.
我们队获胜的消息很快传开了。
We can't ignore the fact that prices are rising.
我们不能忽视物价正在上涨这一事实。
She came up with the idea that we should work from home on Fridays.
她提出了周五在家办公的想法。
q: There is a general belief （ ） exercise is good for mental health.

p: 强调句 It is … that …
use: 把要强调的部分（主语、宾语、状语）放在 It is / was 和 that 之间，强调人时也可以用 who；去掉 It is … that 后句子仍然完整。
eg: It was my grandmother who taught me to cook.
是我奶奶教我做饭的。
It is in this small village that the writer was born.
这位作家正是在这个小村庄出生的。
It wasn't until midnight that he finished the work.
他直到半夜才完成工作。
q: It was at the airport （ ） I lost my wallet.

p: 现在分词作状语 Doing …, …
use: 现在分词短语可以表示时间、原因、伴随等，其逻辑主语必须和主句主语一致，并且与主语是主动关系。
eg: Walking along the river, I saw an old friend.
沿着河边散步时，我碰见了一位老朋友。
Not knowing what to say, she just smiled.
不知道说什么好，她只是笑了笑。
He sat by the window, reading a newspaper.
他坐在窗边看报纸。
q: （ ） the door, he found a package on the floor.

p: 过去分词作状语 Done …, …
use: 过去分词短语作状语时，主句主语与该动词是被动关系，可以表示原因、条件、时间等。
eg: Seen from the top of the hill, the town looks beautiful.
从山顶看，这个小镇很美。
Moved by his story, many people donated money.
很多人被他的故事打动，捐了钱。
Built in the 15th century, the temple is still in good condition.
这座寺庙建于 15 世纪，至今保存完好。
q: （ ） with the result, the coach praised every player.

p: 独立主格 / with 复合结构
use: 分词有自己的逻辑主语时，构成“名词/代词 + 分词”的独立主格；也常用 with + 宾语 + 分词/形容词/介词短语，表示伴随或原因。
eg: Weather permitting, we will go hiking on Saturday.
天气允许的话，我们周六去徒步。
The work done, they went home.
工作做完后，他们回家了。
He fell asleep with the TV still on.
他睡着了，电视还开着。
q: With so much homework （ ）, I can't go out tonight.

p: 形式主语 It is + adj + for / of sb to do
use: 真正的主语（不定式）放到句末，用 it 作形式主语；形容词描述事情时用 for sb，形容词描述人的品质（kind、clever、careless 等）时用 of sb。
eg: It is important for students to get enough sleep.
对学生来说，睡眠充足很重要。
It's very kind of you to help me.
你帮我真是太好了。
It took me two hours to finish the puzzle.
我花了两个小时才拼完这个拼图。
q: It was careless （ ） you to leave your keys in the car.

p: 形式宾语 find / make / think it + adj + to do
m: 发现 / 使 / 认为做……是……的
use: 当宾语是不定式、动名词或从句时，常用 it 作形式宾语，把真正的宾语放到后面：动词 + it + 形容词/名词 + to do / that 从句。
eg: I find it hard to get up early in winter.
我觉得冬天很难早起。
The Internet makes it possible to work from anywhere.
互联网让在任何地方工作都成为可能。
We think it necessary that everyone attend the meeting.
我们认为大家都有必要参加会议。
q: She made （ ） clear that she disagreed with the plan.

p: be used to doing
use: be / get used to + 名词或动名词（to 是介词），表示习惯了某事；注意与 used to do（过去常常）和 be used to do（被用来做）区分。
eg: I'm used to getting up early.
我习惯早起了。
It took her a while to get used to the cold weather.
她过了一段时间才适应这里的寒冷天气。
This knife is used to cut bread.
这把刀是用来切面包的。
q: After living in London for a year, he is used to （ ） on the left.

p: 否定词提前的部分倒装 Never / Seldom / Hardly …
use: never、seldom、hardly、little、rarely 等否定意义的词放在句首时，句子用部分倒装，即把助动词、情态动词或 be 放到主语前。
eg: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
我从来没见过这么美的日落。
Seldom does he eat breakfast at home.
他很少在家吃早饭。
Little did she know that her life was about to change.
她一点也不知道自己的生活即将改变。

p: So / Neither + 助动词 + 主语
use: So + 助动词 / be / 情态动词 + 主语，表示前面的肯定情况也适用于另一个人；否定用 Neither / Nor。注意 So + 主语 + 助动词表示“确实如此”。
eg: — I love spicy food. — So do I.
——我爱吃辣。——我也是。
— I haven't finished yet. — Neither have I.
——我还没完成。——我也没有。
— You look tired. — So I am. I worked late last night.
——你看起来很累。——确实，我昨晚加班到很晚。
q: Tom can play the guitar, and （ ） his sister.

p: no matter what / whatever 等让步从句
use: no matter what / who / how / when / where 引导让步状语从句，相当于 whatever / whoever / however / whenever / wherever；however 后常接形容词或副词。
eg: No matter what happens, I'll support you.
无论发生什么，我都会支持你。
However hard he tried, he couldn't open the jar.
不管他怎么用力，就是打不开那个罐子。
You can sit wherever you like.
你想坐哪儿都行。
q: （ ） late it is, please call me when you get home.

p: although / even though 与 despite / in spite of
use: although / though / even though 是连词，后接句子；despite、in spite of 是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。although 不能和 but 同时使用。
eg: Although it was raining, the match went on.
尽管下着雨，比赛还是继续进行。
Despite the rain, the match went on.
尽管下雨，比赛还是照常进行。
She went to work in spite of feeling ill.
尽管不舒服，她还是去上班了。
q: （ ） his poor eyesight, he reads a book every week.

p: not only … but also …
use: 连接两个并列成分，作主语时谓语与 but also 后的主语一致；not only 放句首连接两个分句时，前一分句要部分倒装。
eg: She is not only a good singer but also a talented dancer.
她不仅歌唱得好，舞也跳得出色。
Not only did he forget my birthday, but he also forgot our dinner plan.
他不仅忘了我的生日，还忘了我们约好的晚饭。
Not only the students but also the teacher was excited.
不仅学生们，连老师也很兴奋。
q: Not only （ ） the exam, but she also got the highest score.

p: the + 比较级, the + 比较级
use: 前半句是条件，后半句是结果，两部分都用“the + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语”的结构；口语中可以省略成 The sooner, the better.
eg: The more you practice, the better you'll get.
你练得越多，就会越好。
The older he grew, the quieter he became.
他年纪越大，人越安静。
— When do you need it? — The sooner, the better.
——你什么时候要？——越快越好。
q: The harder you work, （ ） chance you will have.

p: 使役动词 make / let / have sb do；have sth done
use: make、let、have + 宾语 + 动词原形（不带 to）；have / get + 物 + 过去分词表示“请别人做某事”或“遭遇某事”。make 用于被动时要还原 to：be made to do。
eg: The movie made me cry.
这部电影把我看哭了。
My parents let me choose my own major.
父母让我自己选专业。
I had my hair cut yesterday.
我昨天去剪头发了。
q: I need to （ ） before the trip. It keeps making strange noises.
have checked my car by someone

p: as if / as though
use: 引导方式状语从句或表语从句；内容可能是真的时用陈述语气，与事实相反时用虚拟语气（现在用过去式，过去用 had done）。
eg: It looks as if it's going to snow.
看样子要下雪了。
He talks as if he knew everything.
他说起话来好像什么都知道似的。
She looked at me as though she had never seen me before.
她看着我，好像从来没见过我一样。
q: He treats me as if I （ ） a child, but I'm already twenty.

p: 混合虚拟条件句
use: 条件和结果涉及不同时间：从句与过去相反（had done），主句与现在相反（would do），或反之。根据时间状语（now、yesterday 等）判断各自的形式。
eg: If I had taken the job in Shenzhen, I would be living there now.
要是我当初接了深圳那份工作，现在就住在那儿了。
If she had saved some money, she wouldn't be in trouble now.
她要是当时存了点钱，现在就不会陷入困境了。
If he were more careful, he wouldn't have made that mistake.
要是他细心一点，就不会犯那个错误了。
q: If you had taken the medicine yesterday, you （ ） better now.

p: 省略 if 的虚拟倒装 Had I … / Were I … / Should …
use: 虚拟条件句中含有 had、were、should 时，可以省略 if，并把这三个词提到主语前；否定词 not 不随之提前（Had it not been for…）。
eg: Had I known the truth, I would have acted differently.
如果我早知道真相，我会采取不同的做法。
Were I in your position, I would talk to the manager.
我要是处在你的位置，会去找经理谈谈。
Should you need any help, please let us know.
万一您需要帮助，请告诉我们。
q: （ ） for your timely warning, we would have lost all our data.

p: It is (high / about) time that sb did
use: It is (high / about) time 后的 that 从句用过去式（偶尔用 should do），表示早就该做而还没做；也可以说 It's time for sb to do。
eg: It's time we went home.
我们该回家了。
It's high time the government took action on this problem.
政府早该对这个问题采取行动了。
It's about time you got a haircut.
你早该去理发了。
q: It's high time you （ ） a decision about your future.

p: would rather sb did
m: 宁愿某人……；（我）更希望某人……
use: would rather + 从句时，从句用虚拟：对现在或将来的愿望用过去式，对过去的遗憾用 had done；主语相同时直接用 would rather do。
eg: I'd rather you didn't smoke in the house.
我希望你别在屋里抽烟。
She'd rather we had told her the truth from the start.
她宁愿我们一开始就告诉她真相。
I'd rather stay at home than go out in this weather.
这种天气我宁愿待在家里也不想出门。
q: — Shall I come over tomorrow? — I'd rather you （ ） on Sunday instead.

p: insist / suggest / demand that sb (should) do
m: 坚持 / 建议 / 要求某人……
use: 表示建议、要求、命令的动词（suggest、advise、demand、require、insist、order 等）及其名词或 It is essential / necessary that…，后接的 that 从句用 (should) + 动词原形。
eg: The doctor suggested that he (should) take a few days off.
医生建议他休息几天。
It is essential that every passenger wear a seat belt.
每位乘客都必须系好安全带。
Our manager's request that the report be finished by Friday seemed unrealistic.
经理要求周五前完成报告，这似乎不太现实。
q: The committee recommended that the new rule （ ） immediately.

p: 含蓄虚拟 but for / without / otherwise
use: 条件不用 if 从句表达，而是隐含在 but for、without、otherwise、or 等表达中，主句仍用虚拟语气。
eg: But for your help, I couldn't have finished the project on time.
要不是你的帮助，我不可能按时完成项目。
Without electricity, modern life would be impossible.
没有电，现代生活就无法想象。
I was ill that day; otherwise I would have joined you.
那天我病了，不然我就和你们一起去了。
q: I didn't have your address; otherwise I （ ） you a postcard.

p: Only + 状语 + 部分倒装
use: Only 修饰状语（副词、介词短语、状语从句）放在句首时，主句要部分倒装；Only 修饰主语时不倒装。
eg: Only then did I realize how important family was.
直到那时我才意识到家庭有多重要。
Only by working together can we solve this problem.
只有齐心协力，我们才能解决这个问题。
Only when you lose your health do you understand its value.
只有失去健康时，你才懂得它的可贵。
q: Only after he had left （ ） that he had taken my umbrella.

p: Not until … + 倒装
use: not until 放句首时，主句部分倒装（until 引导的从句本身不倒装）；也可用强调句 It was not until … that … ，此时不倒装。
eg: Not until midnight did the noise stop.
直到半夜噪音才停下来。
Not until I moved abroad did I learn to cook.
直到出国后我才学会做饭。
It was not until the last minute that she changed her mind.
她直到最后一刻才改变了主意。
q: Not until the test results came out （ ） how serious the problem was.

p: No sooner … than / Hardly … when
use: 主句常用过去完成时，从句用一般过去时；no sooner、hardly、scarcely 放在句首时，主句要部分倒装。注意搭配：no sooner…than，hardly / scarcely…when。
eg: No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang.
我刚坐下电话就响了。
Hardly had we arrived when it started to pour.
我们刚到就下起了倾盆大雨。
I had no sooner left the office than I remembered my keys.
我刚离开办公室就想起钥匙没拿。
q: Hardly had the concert begun （ ） the power went off.

p: So / Such … that 提前倒装
use: so + 形容词/副词 或 such + be 放在句首表示强调时，主句要部分倒装：So + adj. + be + 主语 + that…；Such + be + 主语 + that…
eg: So beautiful was the scenery that we forgot to take photos.
风景如此之美，我们都忘了拍照。
So quickly did he speak that I missed half of what he said.
他说得太快了，我漏听了一半。
Such was his anger that he couldn't say a word.
他气得一句话都说不出来。
q: So difficult （ ） that only a few students could answer it.

p: 让步倒装 Adj. / Adv. / N. + as + 主语 + 谓语
use: as 引导让步状语从句时必须倒装，把形容词、副词、动词原形或名词（不带冠词）提到 as 前面，相当于 although。
eg: Tired as she was, she kept working until midnight.
尽管很累，她还是一直工作到半夜。
Child as he is, he knows a lot about history.
虽然他还是个孩子，但懂很多历史知识。
Try as I might, I couldn't remember her name.
我怎么努力也想不起她的名字。

p: 完成式分词 Having done
use: having + 过去分词作状语，强调该动作发生在主句动作之前；被动形式是 having been done。
eg: Having finished the report, she finally went to bed.
写完报告后，她终于去睡了。
Having lived in Japan for years, he speaks Japanese fluently.
他在日本住了很多年，日语说得很流利。
Having been rejected twice, he was nervous about the third interview.
被拒绝过两次后，他对第三次面试很紧张。
q: （ ） all his money, he had to borrow some from his friend.

p: 不定式的完成式与进行式 to have done / to be doing
use: 不定式完成式表示动作发生在谓语之前，进行式表示与谓语同时在进行；常用于 seem、appear、happen、pretend 等动词之后。
eg: He seems to have forgotten our appointment.
他好像忘了我们的约定。
I happened to be walking past when the accident occurred.
事故发生时我刚好路过。
She pretended to have read the book.
她假装读过那本书。
q: The museum appears （ ） a lot since my last visit.

p: sb / sth is said / believed to do
use: It is said / believed / reported that… 可以改写为“主语 + be said / believed / reported + 不定式”；说的是过去的事要用 to have done。
eg: The old castle is said to be haunted.
据说那座古堡闹鬼。
The painting is believed to have been stolen in the 1970s.
人们认为这幅画是在二十世纪七十年代被盗的。
It is reported that the storm will reach the coast tonight.
据报道，风暴今晚将抵达海岸。
q: The ancient bridge is believed （ ） over a thousand years ago.

p: What 分裂句 What … is / was …
use: 用 What 从句作主语，把要强调的信息放在 be 之后，是书面语和口语都常用的强调手段；What I did was (to) … 中的 to 可以省略。
eg: What I need now is a good night's sleep.
我现在需要的是好好睡一觉。
What surprised me was how calm she remained.
让我吃惊的是她始终那么冷静。
What he did was (to) call the police immediately.
他所做的就是马上报了警。
q: （ ） most about the job is the chance to travel.

p: 数量词 / 代词 + of whom / of which
use: 在非限制性定语从句中，用 some / most / all / none / both / neither / 数词 + of + whom（指人）/ which（指物），表示“其中的一部分”。
eg: He has three sons, all of whom are doctors.
他有三个儿子，都是医生。
The company launched ten new products, most of which sold well.
公司推出了十款新产品，大部分都卖得很好。
I asked two people for directions, neither of whom could help me.
我向两个人问路，两个人都帮不上忙。
q: There are 40 students in the class, half of （ ） come from other provinces.

p: as 引导的定语从句 As is known …
use: as 可以引导非限制性定语从句，指代整个主句，位置灵活，可以放在句首（which 不行），常见 as is known to all、as we all know、as has been mentioned。
eg: As is known to all, the earth goes around the sun.
众所周知，地球绕着太阳转。
As I mentioned earlier, the deadline is next Friday.
正如我之前所说，截止日期是下周五。
She is very generous, as her friends can tell you.
她非常大方，这一点她的朋友都可以作证。
q: （ ） is often the case, he arrived late for the meeting.

p: not so much A as B / no more than / no less than
m: 与其说 A 不如说 B；仅仅 / 多达
use: not so much A as B 强调后者；no more than 表示“只不过”，强调少；no less than 表示“多达”，强调多；not more than 则是客观的“不超过”。
eg: He is not so much a teacher as a friend to his students.
对学生来说，他与其说是老师，不如说是朋友。
The trip took no more than two hours.
这趟行程只花了两个小时。
No less than 5,000 people attended the concert.
有多达五千人参加了那场音乐会。
q: Success depends not so much on luck （ ） on hard work.

p: 倍数表达 … times as … as / … times + 比较级 + than
use: 常用结构：A is three times as large as B；A is three times larger than B；A is three times the size of B。half、twice 也可以这样用。
eg: The new stadium is twice as big as the old one.
新体育场是旧体育场的两倍大。
This city's population is three times that of my hometown.
这座城市的人口是我家乡的三倍。
The price of houses here is five times higher than it was twenty years ago.
这里的房价是二十年前的五倍。
q: Our new apartment is three times （ ） our old one.

p: cannot help doing / cannot but do / cannot … too …
m: 忍不住…… / 不得不…… / 再……也不为过
use: can't help doing 表示“忍不住做”；cannot (help) but do 表示“只能、不得不”；cannot + 动词 + too + 形容词/副词表示“越……越好，再……也不为过”。
eg: I couldn't help laughing when I saw his face.
看到他的表情我忍不住笑了。
Faced with such evidence, he could not but admit his mistake.
面对这样的证据，他只好承认了错误。
You can't be too careful when crossing the road.
过马路时越小心越好。
q: The movie was so sad that I couldn't help （ ）.

p: lest / for fear that / in case
use: lest 和 for fear that 引导的从句多用 (should) + 动词原形，书面语色彩较重；in case 后多用一般现在时或 should do，口语常用。
eg: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
带把伞吧，以防下雨。
He spoke quietly lest he (should) wake the baby.
他小声说话，以免吵醒宝宝。
She wrote the number down for fear that she might forget it.
她把号码写了下来，怕自己忘记。
q: The workers wore helmets lest they （ ） by falling objects.

p: be to do
m: 按计划将……；（命运）注定……；应该……
use: be + 不定式可以表示计划安排、命令或义务、注定发生的事；was / were to have done 表示原本计划要做却没做成。
eg: The president is to visit Kenya next month.
总统计划下个月访问肯尼亚。
You are to hand in your essays by Monday.
你们必须在周一前交论文。
He said goodbye, not knowing that he was never to see her again.
他说了再见，并不知道从此再也见不到她了。
q: We （ ） at six, but the flight was cancelled, so we're still here.

p: 动名词的复合结构 one's doing
use: 物主代词或名词所有格 + 动名词，说明动名词的逻辑主语；作宾语时口语中也可以用宾格（him、Tom）。
eg: Do you mind my opening the window?
你介意我开窗吗？
His coming late again annoyed the boss.
他又迟到了，让老板很恼火。
I appreciate your taking the time to meet me.
感谢您抽时间和我见面。
q: We were all surprised at （ ） the competition, since he had only practiced for a month.

p: provided / providing that, on condition that, unless
use: provided (that)、providing (that)、on condition that、as long as 表示“只要、在……条件下”；unless = if … not；它们引导的从句用一般现在时表示将来。
eg: You can borrow my car provided that you return it by Sunday.
只要你周日前还车，就可以借去用。
They agreed to lend him the money on condition that he paid it back within a year.
他们同意借钱给他，条件是一年内还清。
Unless you leave now, you'll miss the train.
你要是现在不走，就会错过火车。
q: You won't be allowed in （ ） you have a ticket.

p: 主谓一致 as well as / neither … nor / the number of
m: 主语和谓语的数要一致
use: A as well as / together with / along with B 作主语时，谓语跟 A 一致；either…or、neither…nor、not only…but also 遵循就近原则；the number of + 复数名词用单数谓语，a number of 用复数谓语。
eg: The teacher, as well as the students, was invited to the party.
老师和学生们都受邀参加了聚会。
Neither my parents nor my brother likes seafood.
我父母和哥哥都不喜欢海鲜。
The number of tourists has increased this year, and a number of hotels are full.
今年游客人数增加了，好几家酒店都已客满。
q: The manager, together with his assistants, （ ） to attend the conference next week.

p: may / might as well do
use: 表示在没有更好的选择时提出建议，语气委婉；might as well A as B 表示“与其做 B 不如做 A，做 B 就像做 A 一样（没用）”。
eg: There's nothing on TV. We may as well go to bed.
电视没什么好看的，我们不如去睡觉吧。
The bus won't come for another hour; we might as well walk.
公交车还要一个小时才来，我们还不如走着去。
You might as well throw your money away as spend it on that.
你把钱花在那上面，跟扔掉没两样。
q: Since the shop is closed, we （ ） go home.

p: 表示情绪的 should
use: 在 It is surprising / strange / a pity that… 或 I'm sorry that… 等表示惊讶、遗憾、愤怒的句子中，that 从句可以用 should + 动词原形，强调说话人的情绪，译为“竟然”。
eg: It's strange that he should say such a thing.
真奇怪，他竟然会说出那种话。
It's a pity that you should miss such a great opportunity.
你竟然错过了这么好的机会，真遗憾。
I'm surprised that she should have refused the offer.
我很惊讶她竟然拒绝了那份工作。
q: It's surprising that such a quiet girl （ ） the lead singer in a rock band.

p: only to do（出乎意料的结果）
use: only to do 作结果状语，表示出乎意料、令人失望的结果，前面常有逗号；而 so as to / in order to 表示目的。
eg: He hurried to the station, only to find the train had left.
他匆匆赶到车站，结果发现火车已经开走了。
She studied all night, only to fall asleep during the exam.
她熬夜复习，结果考试时睡着了。
We drove two hours to the restaurant, only to be told it was fully booked.
我们开了两个小时车到餐厅，却被告知已经订满了。
q: I rushed to the cinema, （ ） that the show had been cancelled.

p: 主语从句 That / Whether … is …
use: 从句作主语时，可以放在句首（That 不能省略），但更常用 It 作形式主语把从句后置；表示“是否”时作主语只能用 whether，不能用 if。
eg: That he lied to us is obvious.
他对我们撒了谎，这很明显。
Whether we go or not depends on the weather.
我们去不去取决于天气。
It remains unclear who will replace the CEO.
还不清楚谁将接替首席执行官。
q: （ ） the plan will work is still uncertain.

p: on / upon doing（一……就……）
use: on / upon + 动名词或名词（如 on arrival），表示一个动作紧接着另一个动作发生，书面语中常见；同义表达还有 as soon as、the moment、immediately。
eg: On hearing the news, she burst into tears.
一听到这个消息，她就哭了起来。
Upon arrival, please report to the front desk.
到达后请到前台报到。
The moment I saw him, I knew something was wrong.
我一看到他就知道出事了。
q: （ ） the top of the mountain, they took out their cameras.

p: 名词复数 -s / -es / 不规则变化
use: 一般加 -s；以 s, x, ch, sh 结尾加 -es；辅音字母 + y 变 y 为 i 加 -es；部分名词不规则：man → men, child → children, foot → feet, mouse → mice。
eg: There are three boxes and two watches on the desk.
桌上有三个盒子和两块手表。
Many families in this city have two children.
这个城市很多家庭有两个孩子。
My feet hurt after the long walk.
走了很远的路，我的脚很疼。
q: The dentist checked all of my （ ） carefully.

p: 不可数名词与量词 a piece of / a cup of
use: water, bread, advice, information, news, furniture 等不可数名词不能直接加 a 或 -s，要借助 a piece of, a cup of, a bottle of, a slice of 等量词表示数量；复数变化在量词上。
eg: Can I have a cup of tea and two slices of bread?
能给我一杯茶和两片面包吗？
My teacher gave me a useful piece of advice.
老师给了我一条有用的建议。
We need to buy some new furniture for the living room.
我们得给客厅买些新家具。
q: Let me give you （ ） about the test.

p: 零冠词 by bus / at school / play football
use: 以下情况通常不加冠词：by + 交通工具（by bus, by train）；三餐（have breakfast）；球类运动（play basketball）；学科和语言；go to school / bed / work 等表示其本来用途时。注意乐器要加 the：play the piano。
eg: I usually go to school by bike.
我通常骑车上学。
We had lunch together and then played tennis.
我们一起吃了午饭，然后打网球。
My brother is good at maths and plays the guitar well.
我哥哥数学很好，吉他也弹得不错。
q: After dinner, the kids often play （ ） in the park.

p: 时间介词 at / on / in
use: at 用于具体钟点和某些时刻（at 7:30, at noon, at night）；on 用于具体某一天或某天的上午/下午（on Monday, on May 1st, on Sunday morning）；in 用于较长时间：月份、年份、季节、上午/下午/晚上（in July, in 2020, in the morning）。
eg: The meeting starts at nine o'clock.
会议九点开始。
We don't have classes on Saturday.
我们星期六不上课。
She was born in 2008, in the spring.
她出生于 2008 年春天。
q: Let's meet at the station （ ） Friday afternoon.

p: 地点介词 in / on / at
use: in 表示在某空间、区域内部（in the room, in China）；on 表示在表面上（on the wall, on the table）；at 表示在某个点或具体地点（at the door, at the bus stop, at home）。
eg: There is a map on the wall.
墙上有一张地图。
My keys are in my bag.
我的钥匙在包里。
Someone is waiting for you at the door.
有人在门口等你。
q: I'll wait for you （ ） the bus stop.

p: 方位介词 under / behind / next to / between
m: 在……下面 / 后面 / 旁边 / 之间
use: under 在……正下方；behind 在……后面（反义 in front of）；next to 紧挨着；between 在两者之间（between A and B），三者及以上之间用 among。
eg: The cat is sleeping under the bed.
猫在床底下睡觉。
There is a small garden behind our school.
我们学校后面有个小花园。
The bank is between the post office and the hotel.
银行在邮局和酒店之间。
q: Mary sits （ ） Tom and Lucy in class.

p: 动作方向介词 into / out of / across / through
m: 进入 / 出来 / 横穿（表面）/ 穿过（内部）
use: 表示移动方向：into 进入里面，out of 从里面出来；across 从一边到另一边，强调在表面（过马路、过桥）；through 从内部穿过（穿过森林、隧道、门）。
eg: He jumped into the river to save the boy.
他跳进河里去救那个男孩。
Look both ways before you walk across the road.
过马路前要看两边。
The train went through a long tunnel.
火车穿过了一条长长的隧道。
q: The sunlight came in （ ） the window.

p: 人称代词主格与宾格 I / me, he / him
m: 我 / 他……（作主语与作宾语）
use: 作主语用主格 I, you, he, she, it, we, they；作动词或介词的宾语用宾格 me, you, him, her, it, us, them。between you and me 中 me 是介词宾语。
eg: She likes him, but he doesn't know it.
她喜欢他，可他不知道。
Please give the book to us.
请把书给我们。
They invited me to their party.
他们邀请我参加聚会。
q: Our teacher asked Tom and （ ） to clean the classroom.

p: 形容词性与名词性物主代词 my / mine
use: 形容词性物主代词（my, your, his, her, its, our, their）后面必须接名词；名词性物主代词（mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs）单独使用，相当于“物主代词 + 名词”。
eg: This is my bike, and that one is yours.
这是我的自行车，那辆是你的。
Their house is bigger than ours.
他们的房子比我们的大。
Is this umbrella hers or his?
这把伞是她的还是他的？

p: 反身代词 myself / yourself
use: 当宾语与主语是同一人时用反身代词（hurt oneself, enjoy oneself）；也可放在名词或句末表示强调“亲自”。固定搭配：help yourself 随便吃，by oneself 独自。
eg: Be careful with the knife, or you'll cut yourself.
小心刀，别割到自己。
We enjoyed ourselves at the beach.
我们在海滩玩得很开心。
The little girl made the cake by herself.
小女孩自己做了这个蛋糕。

p: 指示代词 this / that / these / those
use: this（单数）和 these（复数）指近处的人或物；that（单数）和 those（复数）指远处的人或物。打电话时用 This is … 介绍自己。
eg: This is my friend Jack.
这是我的朋友杰克。
Are those your shoes over there?
那边那双是你的鞋吗？
These cookies taste great.
这些饼干很好吃。
q: Look at （ ） birds in the sky!

p: 名词所有格 's / s' / of
use: 表示人或动物的所有关系通常用 's（Tom's bag）；以 s 结尾的复数名词只加 '（the students' books）；不以 s 结尾的复数加 's（children's toys）；无生命的事物常用 of（the door of the room）。
eg: This is my father's car.
这是我爸爸的车。
The teachers' office is on the second floor.
老师办公室在二楼。
I don't remember the name of the song.
我不记得这首歌的名字了。

p: 祈使句 Do … / Don't … / Let's …
m: 请……/ 不要……/ 我们……吧
use: 祈使句省略主语 you，直接用动词原形开头；否定在句首加 Don't；提议一起做某事用 Let's + 动词原形。语气可以用 please 缓和。
eg: Please close the window.
请关上窗户。
Don't be late for class.
上课别迟到。
Let's take a break.
我们休息一下吧。

p: 特殊疑问词 what / where / when / who / why
m: 什么 / 哪里 / 什么时候 / 谁 / 为什么
use: 特殊疑问句结构：疑问词 + 一般疑问句语序（助动词/be + 主语 + …）；问主语时直接用疑问词 + 谓语（Who called you?）。
eg: Where do you live?
你住在哪儿？
Why were you absent yesterday?
你昨天为什么缺席？
Who broke the window?
谁打破了窗户？

p: How many / How much / How often / How long
m: 多少 / 多少（钱）/ 多久一次 / 多长时间
use: How many + 可数名词复数；How much + 不可数名词或问价格；How often 问频率（回答 once a week 等）；How long 问时间长短或物体长度；How far 问距离。
eg: How many students are there in your class?
你们班有多少学生？
How much is this T-shirt?
这件 T 恤多少钱？
How often do you go swimming? —Twice a week.
你多久游一次泳？——一周两次。
q: —（ ） have you lived here? —For five years.

p: 频率副词 always / usually / often / sometimes / never
m: 总是 / 通常 / 经常 / 有时 / 从不
use: 频率副词一般放在实义动词之前、be 动词和助动词之后（She is always … / I usually get up …）。频率从高到低：always > usually > often > sometimes > seldom > never。
eg: I usually get up at six.
我通常六点起床。
He is always kind to others.
他总是对别人很友好。
My grandma never eats meat.
我奶奶从不吃肉。
q: She walks to school often she.

p: 形容词与副词 careful → carefully
use: 形容词修饰名词或放在系动词后；副词修饰动词、形容词或整句。多数副词由形容词加 -ly 构成；fast, hard, late, early 的形容词与副词同形，good 的副词是 well。
eg: She is a careful driver. She drives carefully.
她是个谨慎的司机，开车很小心。
He works hard every day.
他每天都努力工作。
You speak English very well.
你英语说得很好。
q: Please read the instructions （ ） before you start.

p: 系动词 + 形容词 look / sound / feel / taste / smell
m: 看起来 / 听起来 / 摸起来 / 尝起来 / 闻起来……
use: 感官系动词后面接形容词作表语，不接副词：look happy, sound great, taste sweet。接名词时要用 like：It looks like rain.
eg: You look tired today.
你今天看起来很累。
That sounds like a good idea.
听起来是个好主意。
This soup tastes a bit salty.
这汤尝起来有点咸。
q: The flowers in the garden smell （ ）.

p: 并列连词 and / but / or / so
m: 和 / 但是 / 或者、否则 / 所以
use: and 表并列或顺承；but 表转折；or 表选择，在祈使句后表示“否则”；so 表结果。祈使句 + and 表示“那么就会……”。
eg: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
我累了，所以早早睡了。
Hurry up, or you'll miss the bus.
快点，不然你会错过公交车。
Work hard, and you will pass the exam.
努力学习，你就会通过考试。
q: The bag is nice, （ ） it's too expensive for me.

p: because / because of
use: because 是连词，后接句子；because of 是介词短语，后接名词或代词。英语中 because 和 so 不能在同一句里连用。
eg: We stayed at home because it was raining.
因为下雨，我们待在家里。
The game was put off because of the rain.
比赛因雨推迟了。
I didn't go because I had a cold.
我没去，因为我感冒了。
q: The flight was delayed （ ） the heavy fog.

p: may / might 表示许可与可能
use: May I …? 礼貌地请求许可，肯定回答 Yes, you may / Sure，否定常用 No, you can't / I'm afraid not；may / might 表示“可能”，might 的可能性更小。注意 may be（情态动词 + be）和 maybe（副词“也许”）的区别。
eg: May I use your phone?
我可以用一下你的电话吗？
Take an umbrella. It may rain later.
带把伞吧，晚点可能会下雨。
He might be at the library, but I'm not sure.
他可能在图书馆，但我不确定。
q: Don't wait for me. I （ ） be late tonight.

p: would like / want 表示愿望
use: would like（'d like）比 want 更礼貌：would like + 名词 / to do；Would you like …? 用于邀请或提供东西，回答 Yes, please / I'd love to。
eg: I'd like a glass of orange juice, please.
请给我来一杯橙汁。
Would you like to come to my party?
你愿意来参加我的聚会吗？
She wants to be a doctor in the future.
她将来想当医生。

p: 双宾语 give sb sth / give sth to sb
use: give, show, send, lend, pass 等可接双宾语：动词 + 人 + 物，或 动词 + 物 + to + 人；buy, make, cook 等用 for：buy sth for sb。物是代词（it / them）时一般用介词结构：give it to me。
eg: My uncle gave me a new watch.
叔叔送给我一块新手表。
Could you pass the salt to me?
你能把盐递给我吗？
Mom bought a dress for my sister.
妈妈给我妹妹买了一条裙子。
q: This is Lily's book. Please give （ ）.

p: 不定代词 something / anything / nobody
m: 某事 / 任何事 / 没人……
use: some- 用于肯定句，any- 用于否定句和疑问句（表示请求、建议的疑问句用 some-）；no- 本身表示否定。修饰这类词的形容词放在后面：something interesting。它们作主语时谓语用单数。
eg: There is something wrong with my computer.
我的电脑出了点问题。
I didn't buy anything at the market.
我在市场上什么也没买。
Nobody knows the answer.
没人知道答案。

p: both / either / neither（两者）
m: 两者都 / 两者之一 / 两者都不
use: 用于两者：both 两个都（谓语用复数）；either 两者中任一个；neither 两者都不（作主语时谓语多用单数）。三者及以上用 all / any / none。
eg: Both of my parents are teachers.
我父母都是老师。
You can sit on either side of the table.
你可以坐在桌子的任何一边。
Neither of the answers is correct.
两个答案都不对。
q: I asked two friends, but （ ） of them could help me.

p: few / a few / little / a little
m: 很少几个 / 有几个 / 很少一点 / 有一点
use: few / a few 修饰可数名词复数，little / a little 修饰不可数名词；不带 a 表示否定意味“几乎没有”，带 a 表示肯定意味“有一些”。
eg: Hurry up! We have little time left.
快点！我们几乎没时间了。
I have a few friends in Shanghai.
我在上海有几个朋友。
Very few people came to the meeting.
几乎没人来开会。
q: Don't worry. There is still （ ） milk in the fridge.

p: each / every
use: every 只能放在单数名词前，强调整体“每一个都”，不能单独使用；each 强调个体，可以单独用或用 each of + 复数名词。两者作主语时谓语都用单数。
eg: Every student in our class has a computer.
我们班每个学生都有电脑。
Each of the boys has a different hobby.
每个男孩都有不同的爱好。
She gave a gift to each of us.
她给我们每人一份礼物。
q: （ ） of the children got a balloon.

p: it 表示时间、天气、距离
use: 说时间、日期、天气、温度、距离时，用 it 作主语，it 本身没有意思：It's ten o'clock. / It's raining. / It's two kilometers from here.
eg: It's very cold today.
今天很冷。
What time is it now? —It's half past seven.
现在几点？——七点半。
It's about ten minutes' walk to the station.
到车站步行大约十分钟。
q: （ ） is about 120 kilometers from Beijing to Tianjin.

p: stop / remember / forget doing 与 to do
m: 停止做 / 停下来去做；记得做过 / 记得要做
use: stop doing 停止正在做的事，stop to do 停下来去做另一件事；remember / forget doing 指记得 / 忘记已经做过的事，remember / forget to do 指记得 / 忘记要去做的事。
eg: The baby stopped crying when her mother came in.
妈妈一进来，婴儿就不哭了。
Halfway up the hill, we stopped to take a rest.
爬到半山腰，我们停下来休息。
I remember locking the door, so don't worry.
我记得锁过门了，别担心。
q: Don't forget （ ） the plants while I'm away.

p: try / mean / regret / go on doing 与 to do
m: 动词接 doing 和 to do 意义不同
use: try to do 努力做，try doing 尝试着做（看效果）；mean to do 打算做，mean doing 意味着；regret to do 遗憾地要（告知），regret doing 后悔做过；go on to do 接着做另一件事，go on doing 继续做同一件事。
eg: If the light doesn't work, try changing the bulb.
灯不亮的话，试试换个灯泡。
Missing this train means waiting another hour.
错过这班车就意味着再等一个小时。
We regret to inform you that your application was unsuccessful.
我们遗憾地通知您，您的申请未获通过。
q: I regret （ ） so rudely to my mother yesterday.

p: 间接引语：时态后移与时间状语变化
use: 主句谓语是过去时，转述时从句时态通常向过去推一步（am → was, will → would, did → had done），人称、指示代词和时间地点状语也要相应变化（now → then, today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, here → there）。转述客观真理时时态不变。
eg: "I'm busy now," she said. → She said (that) she was busy then.
她说她那时很忙。
He told me he would call me the next day.
他跟我说他第二天会给我打电话。
The teacher said that the earth goes around the sun.
老师说地球绕着太阳转。
q: "I have finished my homework," Tom said. → Tom said that he （ ） his homework.

p: 间接引语：疑问句和祈使句的转述
use: 一般疑问句转述用 asked + if / whether + 陈述语序；特殊疑问句用 asked + 疑问词 + 陈述语序；祈使句用 tell / ask sb (not) to do。
eg: She asked me if I liked spicy food.
她问我喜不喜欢吃辣。
He asked where the nearest bank was.
他问最近的银行在哪儿。
The doctor told me not to stay up late.
医生叫我不要熬夜。
q: "Please don't touch the paintings," the guide said. → The guide told us （ ） the paintings.

p: 短语动词：可分与不可分 turn it off / look after it
m: 动词 + 副词 / 动词 + 介词
use: “动词 + 副词”型（turn off, pick up, give up, put on）可分：名词宾语放中间或后面都行，代词宾语必须放中间（turn it off）；“动词 + 介词”型（look after, look for, deal with）不可分，宾语一律放介词后面。
eg: It's cold. Put your coat on. / Put on your coat.
天冷，把外套穿上。
The radio is too loud. Please turn it down.
收音机太吵了，请调小一点。
Who will look after the dog when we're away?
我们不在时谁来照看狗？

p: 三词短语动词 look forward to / put up with / come up with
m: 盼望 / 忍受 / 想出
use: “动词 + 副词 + 介词”构成的三词短语动词不可拆分，宾语放最后。注意 look forward to, be used to 等中的 to 是介词，后面接名词或动名词。
eg: I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
期待你的回信。
I can't put up with the noise any longer.
我再也受不了这噪音了。
She came up with a clever solution.
她想出了一个巧妙的办法。
q: We're all looking forward to （ ） the new museum.

p: 感官动词 see / hear / watch sb do / doing
m: 看见 / 听见某人做了（正在做）某事
use: see, hear, watch, notice, feel 后接宾语 + 动词原形，表示看到动作的全过程；接宾语 + doing 表示看到动作正在进行。变被动时原形前要加 to：He was seen to enter the room.
eg: I saw him cross the street and get into a taxi.
我看见他穿过马路上了出租车。
When I passed by, I heard someone singing upstairs.
我经过时听见楼上有人在唱歌。
She felt something crawl up her arm.
她觉得有东西爬上了她的胳膊。
q: As I walked past the room, I heard two people （ ） loudly.

p: 多个形容词修饰名词的顺序
use: 多个形容词并列修饰名词时一般顺序为：观点评价 → 大小 → 年龄新旧 → 形状 → 颜色 → 来源国籍 → 材料 → 用途 + 名词，如 a lovely small old round red Italian wooden dining table。
eg: She bought a beautiful long silk dress.
她买了一条漂亮的长丝绸连衣裙。
We stayed in a small old wooden house.
我们住在一座小小的旧木屋里。
He has a big black German dog.
他有一条大黑德国狗。

p: -ed 与 -ing 形容词 bored / boring
m: 感到无聊的 / 令人无聊的
use: -ed 形容词描述人的感受（I'm interested / excited / surprised）；-ing 形容词描述事物本身的特征，即“令人……的”（an interesting book / exciting news）。
eg: The movie was so boring that I fell asleep.
电影太无聊了，我都睡着了。
I was really surprised at the news.
听到那个消息我真的很惊讶。
It was an exhausting journey, and we were all exhausted.
那是一段让人筋疲力尽的旅程，我们都累坏了。
q: We were all （ ） when we heard the results.

p: 目的状语 in order to / so as to / so that
use: in order to / so as to + 动词原形表示目的，否定为 in order not to / so as not to（so as to 不放句首）；主语不同或要用情态动词时用 so that / in order that + 从句（常含 can / could / will / would）。
eg: She got up early in order to catch the first bus.
她早起是为了赶上头班车。
Speak quietly so as not to wake the baby.
小声说话，以免吵醒宝宝。
I'll explain it again so that everyone can understand.
我再解释一遍，好让大家都能听懂。
q: He wrote down the address （ ） forget it.

p: while / whereas 表示对比
use: while 除了表示“当……时候”，还可以连接两个分句，表示对比“而”；whereas 只表示对比，更正式。两者都用逗号隔开对比的两部分。
eg: My sister loves sports, while I prefer reading.
我姐姐喜欢运动，而我更喜欢读书。
Some people enjoy city life, whereas others prefer the countryside.
有人喜欢城市生活，而有人更喜欢乡村。
Summer here is hot and dry, while winter is mild and wet.
这里夏天炎热干燥，而冬天温和湿润。
q: Tom is outgoing, （ ） his twin brother is very shy.

p: 定语从句 whose
use: whose 在定语从句中作定语，表示所属关系，后面必须紧跟名词，既可以指人也可以指物，相当于 of whom / of which。
eg: I have a friend whose father is a pilot.
我有个朋友，他爸爸是飞行员。
This is the house whose roof was damaged in the storm.
这就是屋顶在暴风雨中受损的那所房子。
The student whose phone rang in class apologized.
上课时手机响的那个学生道了歉。
q: The woman （ ） car was stolen called the police.

p: 定语从句只用 that / 关系代词的省略
m: 必须用 that 的情况；省略关系代词
use: 先行词是 all, everything, nothing 等不定代词，或被最高级、序数词、the only, the very 修饰，或人和物并列时，关系代词通常用 that；关系代词在从句中作宾语时（且前面没有介词）可以省略。
eg: This is the best film (that) I have ever seen.
这是我看过的最好的电影。
All that glitters is not gold.
闪光的未必都是金子。
The man (who) you met yesterday is my uncle.
你昨天见到的那个人是我叔叔。
q: Is there anything （ ） I can do for you?

p: ask / tell / want / encourage sb to do
m: 要求 / 告诉 / 想要 / 鼓励某人做某事
use: ask, tell, want, invite, advise, encourage, allow, expect, warn 等动词后接“宾语 + to do”作宾补；否定形式是 sb not to do。
eg: My parents encouraged me to study abroad.
父母鼓励我出国留学。
The teacher warned us not to cheat in the exam.
老师警告我们考试不要作弊。
I want you to be honest with me.
我希望你对我坦诚。
q: The manager asked everyone （ ） the meeting room at 3 p.m.

p: 不定式作定语 something to eat / the first to arrive
use: 不定式放在名词或不定代词后面作定语，表示将要发生的动作或用途；不定式动词是不及物动词时要带介词（a house to live in, a pen to write with）；被 first, last, only 修饰的名词常用不定式作定语。
eg: I'm hungry. Is there anything to eat?
我饿了，有什么吃的吗？
She was the first person to finish the race.
她是第一个跑完全程的人。
They are looking for a quiet place to live in.
他们在找一个安静的地方住。

p: 过去将来时 would do / was going to do
use: 以过去某时为参照表示“将要发生”的动作，用 would do 或 was / were going to do，多用于宾语从句和间接引语中。was going to do 还可以表示“原本打算做（但没做）”。
eg: She said she would come back soon.
她说她很快就回来。
I knew it was going to rain, so I took an umbrella.
我知道要下雨，所以带了伞。
I was going to call you, but I forgot.
我本来想给你打电话，但是忘了。
q: He promised that he （ ） help me with my maths.

p: 时间 / 条件状语从句中用现在时表将来
use: 在 when, as soon as, before, after, until, if, unless 引导的时间或条件状语从句中，用一般现在时表示将来，主句才用将来时。注意宾语从句中的 if / when 不受这个规则限制。
eg: I'll call you as soon as I arrive.
我一到就给你打电话。
If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。
We'll wait here until the rain stops.
我们在这儿等到雨停。
q: Please give him this note when he （ ） back.

p: by 与 until 表示时间
m: 到……为止（完成）/ 一直到……（持续）
use: by 表示“最迟在……之前”，强调动作在那之前完成；until / till 表示动作或状态一直持续到某时。否定句 not … until 表示“直到……才”。
eg: Please hand in your report by Friday.
请在周五前交报告。
The shop is open until ten p.m.
商店营业到晚上十点。
By the time we got there, the film had started.
等我们到的时候，电影已经开始了。
q: You must return the library books （ ） next Monday at the latest.

p: for / during / while 表示时间段
m: （持续）……之久 / 在……期间 / 当……时
use: for + 时间长度，表示持续多久（for two hours）；during + 名词，表示在某段时期内（during the holiday）；while 是连词，后接从句（while I was sleeping）。
eg: I lived in London for three years.
我在伦敦住了三年。
Nobody spoke during the meal.
吃饭时没人说话。
Someone called while you were out.
你出去的时候有人打来电话。
q: My phone was stolen （ ） my trip to Paris.

p: 修饰比较级 much / even / far / a little
use: 比较级前可以用 much, far, a lot, even, still 表示程度大，用 a little, a bit, slightly 表示程度小；不能用 very 或 more 修饰比较级。
eg: This box is much heavier than that one.
这个箱子比那个重得多。
It was cold yesterday, but today it's even colder.
昨天很冷，今天更冷。
She is a little taller than her mother.
她比她妈妈稍微高一点。
q: The new phone is （ ） faster than the old one.

p: 同级比较 as … as / not as (so) … as
use: as + 形容词 / 副词原级 + as 表示程度相同；否定 not as / so … as 表示“不如”；中间用原级，不能用比较级。
eg: My bag is as heavy as yours.
我的包和你的一样重。
This test was not as difficult as I expected.
这次考试没我想的那么难。
Please come as soon as possible.
请尽快来。
q: Tom runs as （ ） as his older brother.

p: mustn't / needn't / don't have to
m: 禁止 / 不必 / 不必
use: mustn't 表示“禁止、不允许”；needn't 和 don't have to 都表示“不必”。回答 Must I …? 的否定用 No, you needn't / don't have to，而不用 mustn't。
eg: You mustn't smoke in the hospital.
医院里禁止吸烟。
You needn't bring anything. We have everything.
你什么都不用带，我们都准备好了。
Tomorrow is Sunday, so I don't have to get up early.
明天星期天，我不用早起。
q: —Must I finish it today? —No, you （ ）. Tomorrow is fine.

p: had better (not) do
use: had better 后接动词原形，表示建议或带有警告意味，缩写为 'd better；否定是 had better not do，不能说 hadn't better 或 had better not to。
eg: You'd better see a doctor.
你最好去看医生。
We'd better leave now, or we'll miss the train.
我们最好现在走，否则会错过火车。
You'd better not tell him the truth yet.
你最好暂时别告诉他真相。
q: It's very late. You （ ） drive home alone.

p: 被动语态中省略 to 的还原 be made / seen to do
use: 主动语态中 make, let 以外的使役动词和 see, hear, watch 等感官动词后的不带 to 的不定式，在变成被动语态时要加上 to：make sb do → sb be made to do。let 的被动常改用 be allowed to do。
eg: The workers were made to work twelve hours a day.
工人们被迫每天工作十二小时。
He was heard to say that he would quit.
有人听到他说要辞职。
The children were allowed to stay up late on New Year's Eve.
除夕夜孩子们可以晚睡。
q: The boy was made （ ） the window he had broken.

p: get + 过去分词 get hurt / get married
use: get + 过去分词可以表示被动，多用于口语，强调动作的结果或意外发生的事（get hurt, get lost, get stolen）；也有固定说法：get married, get dressed, get changed。
eg: Be careful, or you'll get hurt.
小心，不然会受伤的。
My bike got stolen last night.
我的自行车昨晚被偷了。
They got married last spring.
他们去年春天结婚了。
q: We （ ） in the old town because we didn't have a map.

p: 动词 + 介词搭配 depend on / consist of / result in
m: 取决于 / 由……组成 / 导致
use: 很多动词需要固定介词：depend on, rely on, consist of, belong to, apologize to sb for sth, result in（导致某结果）与 result from（由某原因引起）方向相反。
eg: Whether we go depends on the weather.
我们去不去取决于天气。
The team consists of five engineers.
这个团队由五名工程师组成。
The accident resulted from careless driving.
这起事故是由驾驶疏忽造成的。
q: Lack of sleep can （ ） poor concentration.

p: 形容词 + 介词搭配 be good at / be afraid of / be responsible for
m: 擅长 / 害怕 / 对……负责
use: 形容词后接固定介词：be good at, be interested in, be afraid of, be proud of, be famous for, be responsible for, be similar to, be different from；介词后接名词或动名词。
eg: She is good at solving problems.
她擅长解决问题。
Hangzhou is famous for its West Lake.
杭州以西湖闻名。
Who is responsible for this project?
谁负责这个项目？
q: My grandfather is very proud （ ） his garden.

p: 分词作定语 the girl standing there / a broken window
use: 现在分词作定语表示主动或正在进行（the man talking to Lucy），过去分词作定语表示被动或已完成（a broken cup, the books written by Lu Xun）；单个分词一般放在名词前，分词短语放在名词后。
eg: Who is the girl standing by the window?
站在窗边的那个女孩是谁？
Be careful with the broken glass.
小心碎玻璃。
Most of the products made in this factory are exported.
这家工厂生产的产品大部分出口。
q: The language （ ） in Brazil is Portuguese.

p: 替代词 one / ones / that / those
use: one / ones 代替前面提到的同类可数名词中的“一个 / 一些”（泛指，可加修饰语）；that 代替前面提到的特指的单数名词或不可数名词，those 代替特指的复数名词，常用于比较句：that of …。
eg: I don't like this shirt. Can I see a cheaper one?
我不喜欢这件衬衫，能看看便宜点的吗？
The population of China is larger than that of Japan.
中国的人口比日本多。
The prices here are higher than those in my hometown.
这里的物价比我家乡的高。
q: The climate here is milder than （ ） of the north.

p: The reason (why) … is that …
use: reason 作主语时，表语从句应该用 that 引导，而不用 because（The reason … is because … 在正式写作中被视为冗余）；reason 后的定语从句可以用 why / that 或省略。
eg: The reason why he was late is that his car broke down.
他迟到的原因是车坏了。
The main reason for the delay was that the data were incomplete.
延误的主要原因是数据不完整。
The reason I called is that I need your advice.
我打电话是因为需要你的建议。
q: The reason she quit her job was （ ） she wanted to start her own business.

p: 伪分裂句 All (that) … is / The only thing … is (to) do
use: All (that) / The only thing / The last thing + 从句 + be + 表语，用于强调；从句中含 do 时，表语可用不带 to 的不定式（All you have to do is press the button）。注意 All 在这里相当于 the only thing，谓语用单数。
eg: All I want is a quiet weekend.
我只想过个安静的周末。
All you need to do is fill in this form.
你只需要填好这张表。
The last thing I expected was an apology from him.
我最没想到的就是他会道歉。
q: All we could do （ ） wait for the rescue team.

p: 不定式省略：只保留 to
use: 为避免重复，不定式中的动词及其后成分在上下文清楚时可以省略，只保留 to，常见于 want, would like / love, hope, try, plan, be going to, used to, ought to 之后；保留的是 be 时不能省略 be：I'd like to be.
eg: —Would you like to join us? —I'd love to.
——你愿意和我们一起吗？——很乐意。
I didn't finish the report, though I meant to.
我没写完报告，虽然我本打算写完的。
He doesn't smoke now, but he used to.
他现在不抽烟了，但以前抽。
q: —Why didn't you call me? —I was going （ ）, but my phone died.

p: 状语从句的省略 if possible / when necessary / though tired
m: 如果可能 / 必要时 / 虽然累
use: 当状语从句（when, while, if, unless, though, once, as if 引导）的主语与主句主语一致或为 it，且谓语含 be 时，可以省略从句的主语和 be，保留形容词、分词、名词或介词短语。
eg: Though exhausted, she kept on working.
虽然筋疲力尽，她还是继续工作。
Call me if necessary.
必要的话给我打电话。
When asked about the plan, he refused to comment.
被问到这个计划时，他拒绝评论。
q: （ ）, this medicine must be kept in the fridge.

p: so / not 替代从句 I think so / I'm afraid not
m: 我想是的 / 恐怕不是
use: 在 think, believe, suppose, expect, hope, be afraid 等之后用 so 代替肯定的 that 从句，用 not 代替否定从句；但 think, believe, suppose, expect 的否定更常说 I don't think so，hope 和 be afraid 只能用 I hope not / I'm afraid not。
eg: —Will it rain tomorrow? —I hope not.
——明天会下雨吗？——希望不会。
—Is she coming? —I believe so.
——她会来吗？——我相信会的。
—Can we still get tickets? —I'm afraid not.
——还能买到票吗？——恐怕不行。
q: —Will the flight be cancelled? —I hope （ ）. I have an important meeting.

p: do so / do it / do that 替代谓语
use: do so 替代前面提到的动作性动词短语，避免重复，正式语体常用；do it / do that 也可替代，但更强调具体的某件事；状态动词（know, like, be）不能用 do so 替代。
eg: He promised to call back, but he never did so.
他答应回电话，却一直没回。
Visitors may take photos, but they must not do so with a flash.
游客可以拍照，但不得使用闪光灯。
If you want to leave early, you should ask before doing so.
你要是想早退，得先请示。
q: The board asked him to resign, and he （ ） the following week.

p: 转折让步标记 however / nevertheless / nonetheless
use: however 是副词，不能单独连接两个分句，前面要用句号或分号，后面加逗号；nevertheless / nonetheless 比 however 更正式，强调“尽管前面说的是事实，但仍然……”。
eg: The plan was risky; nevertheless, they decided to go ahead.
这个计划有风险，尽管如此，他们还是决定实施。
The hotel was expensive. However, the service was excellent.
这家酒店很贵，然而服务很好。
The evidence is limited. It is, nonetheless, worth considering.
证据有限，但仍然值得考虑。
q: The task was extremely difficult. （ ）, the team completed it on time.

p: 递进标记 moreover / furthermore / in addition / what's more
use: 用于引出补充的、通常更有说服力的论点；moreover / furthermore 较正式，what's more 偏口语；in addition 后接名词时用 in addition to sth / doing。它们都是副词性成分，不能单独连接两个分句。
eg: The apartment is close to the subway. Moreover, the rent is reasonable.
这套公寓离地铁近，而且房租合理。
In addition to teaching, she writes novels.
除了教书，她还写小说。
The plan is too costly. Furthermore, it would take years to complete.
这个计划成本太高，此外还需要好几年才能完成。
q: Exercise improves your physical health. （ ）, it helps reduce stress.

p: 解释说明标记 in other words / that is (to say) / namely
m: 换句话说 / 也就是说 / 即
use: in other words 用更简单的说法重新表述前文；that is (to say) 进一步解释或修正；namely 引出具体所指的内容，常列举名称或项目。
eg: He's economical with the truth — in other words, he lies.
他对真相有所保留，换句话说，他撒谎。
Two students, namely Lily and Mark, won scholarships.
两名学生，即莉莉和马克，获得了奖学金。
The course is for beginners, that is, people with no experience.
这门课面向初学者，也就是没有经验的人。
q: Only one country, （ ） Brazil, has won the World Cup five times.

p: 因果标记 consequently / hence / thus / as a result
use: 这些表示结果的副词或短语用于句首或分号后，比 so 更正式；hence 后面可以直接跟名词短语（hence the name …）。as a result of + 名词表示原因。
eg: He didn't prepare well; consequently, he failed the interview.
他准备不充分，结果面试没通过。
The town is built on seven hills, hence its nickname.
这座城镇建在七座山丘上，由此得了这个绰号。
As a result of the drought, crop yields fell sharply.
由于干旱，农作物产量大幅下降。
q: The roads were icy; （ ）, many flights and trains were delayed.

p: 名词化：用名词短语代替动词 make a decision
use: 学术和正式写作中常把动词、形容词转换成名词短语，使表达更简洁客观：decide → make a decision，improve → bring about an improvement，analyze → carry out an analysis，be able → have the ability。
eg: The committee will make a final decision next week.
委员会将于下周作出最终决定。
The new policy brought about a significant improvement in air quality.
新政策使空气质量显著改善。
Researchers carried out a detailed analysis of the data.
研究人员对数据进行了详细分析。
q: The government has （ ） an investigation into the incident.

p: 名词化：the + 名词 + of 代替从句
use: 把“主语 + 谓语”结构变成“the + 名词 + of + 名词”作句子成分，使信息更紧凑：Cities grow rapidly, which causes … → The rapid growth of cities causes …；副词相应变成形容词。
eg: The rapid growth of cities has put pressure on housing.
城市的快速发展给住房带来了压力。
His failure to respond surprised everyone.
他没有回应，令所有人吃惊。
The introduction of new technology changed the industry.
新技术的引进改变了这个行业。
q: （ ） has led to a shortage of skilled workers in the countryside.
The rapid movement of young people to cities
Young people move rapidly to cities
Rapidly moving of young people to cities
The young people rapid moving to cities

p: 副词 + 形容词的强调搭配 highly / deeply / bitterly
use: 英语中程度副词与形容词有固定搭配，不能随意替换：highly likely / recommended / successful，deeply concerned / moved，bitterly disappointed / cold，fully aware，utterly ridiculous，widely accepted。
eg: It is highly likely that prices will rise again.
价格很可能会再次上涨。
We are deeply concerned about the situation.
我们对局势深感关切。
The fans were bitterly disappointed by the defeat.
球迷们对这场失利极为失望。
q: It is （ ） likely that the meeting will be postponed.

p: 名词 + 介词搭配 impact on / threat to / solution to
m: 对……的影响 / 威胁 / 解决办法
use: 抽象名词有固定介词搭配：impact / effect / influence on，threat / solution / key / access / approach to，demand / need / respect for，increase / decline in（某方面的增减）。
eg: Social media has a huge impact on young people.
社交媒体对年轻人影响巨大。
Plastic waste poses a serious threat to marine life.
塑料垃圾对海洋生物构成严重威胁。
There has been a sharp increase in online shopping.
网购大幅增加。
q: Rising sea levels pose a real threat （ ） coastal cities.

p: 动词 + 名词搭配 make / take / pay / raise
use: 不少名词只与特定动词搭配：make progress / an effort / a mistake，take measures / action / responsibility，pay attention / a visit / tribute，raise awareness / a question / funds，do harm / research；不能凭中文直译。
eg: The government must take effective measures to cut pollution.
政府必须采取有效措施减少污染。
The campaign aims to raise awareness of mental health.
这项活动旨在提高人们对心理健康的认识。
She has made great progress in her Spanish.
她的西班牙语进步很大。
q: Students should （ ） full responsibility for their own learning.

p: 复合介词 in terms of / with regard to / in light of
m: 就……而言 / 关于 / 鉴于
use: 正式文体常用复合介词：in terms of 从……方面来说；with regard to / regarding 关于；in light of / in view of 鉴于，考虑到；on behalf of 代表；in accordance with 按照。后面接名词或动名词。
eg: In terms of price, this model is the best choice.
就价格而言，这款是最佳选择。
With regard to your request, we will reply within a week.
关于您的请求，我们将在一周内答复。
In light of the new evidence, the case was reopened.
鉴于新的证据，此案重新审理。
q: I am writing （ ） all the staff to thank you for your support.

p: 独立成分 to be honest / generally speaking / judging from
m: 说实话 / 一般来说 / 从……判断
use: 一些不定式、现在分词短语作插入语，表达说话人的态度，其逻辑主语不必与句子主语一致：to be honest, to tell the truth, to begin with, so to speak；generally / frankly / strictly speaking, judging from / by, considering。
eg: To be honest, I didn't enjoy the film.
说实话，我不喜欢那部电影。
Generally speaking, women live longer than men.
一般来说，女性比男性寿命长。
Judging from his accent, he must be from Scotland.
从口音判断，他一定是苏格兰人。
q: （ ） from the dark clouds, it's going to rain soon.

p: 悬垂修饰：分词的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致
use: 句首的分词短语、不定式短语或省略从句，其逻辑主语必须是主句的主语，否则就是语病。例如 Walking into the room, the lights went off. 是错句（灯不会走路），应改为 Walking into the room, I noticed …
eg: Walking along the beach, we found a beautiful shell.
沿着海滩散步时，我们发现了一个漂亮的贝壳。
Seen from the hill, the city looks like a map.
从山上看，这座城市像一张地图。
Having finished the report, she went home.
写完报告后她回家了。
q: Arriving at the airport two hours late, （ ）.
we found that our flight had left
the plane took off without us
it was too late to check in

p: 平行结构 parallelism
use: 由 and, or, but, not only … but also, both … and, rather than 等连接的并列成分在语法形式上应保持一致：名词对名词、动名词对动名词、不定式对不定式、从句对从句。
eg: She enjoys reading, swimming, and traveling.
她喜欢读书、游泳和旅行。
The goal is not only to win but also to learn.
目标不仅是赢，也是学习。
He decided to walk rather than take a taxi.
他决定步行而不是打车。
q: Good leaders listen carefully, speak clearly, and （ ） quickly.

p: It occurs to sb that / It dawns on sb that
m: 某人突然想到 / 渐渐意识到……
use: it 作形式主语，真正的主语是后面的 that 从句或不定式：It occurred to me that … 我突然想到；It dawned on him that … 他恍然大悟；It never occurred to me to ask. 我从没想到要问。主语不能是人：不能说 I occurred …
eg: It suddenly occurred to me that I had left my keys at the office.
我突然想起钥匙落在办公室了。
It finally dawned on her that he had been lying.
她终于意识到他一直在撒谎。
It never occurred to him to ask for help.
他从没想到要找人帮忙。
q: （ ） that I could solve the problem in a different way.

p: whoever / whatever 引导名词性从句
m: 任何……的人 / 任何……的事物
use: whoever = anyone who，whatever = anything that，可以引导主语从句或宾语从句，在从句中作主语或宾语；注意与让步状语从句 whoever / whatever（无论……）区别：名词性从句不能换成 no matter who / what。
eg: Whoever wins the race will get a medal.
谁赢了比赛谁就能得到奖牌。
You can invite whoever you like.
你想请谁就请谁。
She always does whatever her coach tells her.
教练让她做什么她就做什么。
q: The prize will go to （ ） comes up with the best idea.

p: prefer to do rather than do / prefer A to B
use: prefer doing A to doing B 或 prefer A to B（to 是介词）；表示具体一次的偏好时常用 prefer to do A rather than (do) B。注意不要把 to 和 than 混用。
eg: I prefer tea to coffee.
比起咖啡我更喜欢茶。
She prefers walking to driving.
她更喜欢走路而不是开车。
I'd prefer to stay in rather than go out tonight.
今晚我宁愿待在家里也不想出去。
q: Many young people prefer to rent a flat （ ） buy one.

p: if only + 虚拟
use: if only 表达强烈的愿望或遗憾，比 I wish 语气更强：与现在事实相反用过去式（were），与过去事实相反用 had done，对将来的愿望用 would / could do。
eg: If only I were taller!
要是我再高一点就好了！
If only I had listened to your advice.
要是我当初听了你的建议就好了。
If only the rain would stop!
雨要是能停就好了！
q: If only I （ ） the exam more seriously last term!

p: would do 表示过去的习惯（与 used to 的区别）
use: would do 可以表示过去反复发生的动作，多用于回忆性叙述，但不能表示过去的状态；used to 既可表示过去的动作也可表示过去的状态（used to be / live / have），且强调“现在不再如此”。
eg: When I was a child, my grandfather would tell me stories every night.
小时候，爷爷每天晚上都会给我讲故事。
On Sundays we would go fishing in the river.
星期天我们常常到河里钓鱼。
There used to be a cinema on this corner.
这个街角以前有一家电影院。
q: There （ ） a big tree in front of our house, but it was cut down.

p: 完全倒装：地点 / 方向状语前置 Here comes … / On the hill stands …
use: 表示地点或方向的副词（here, there, out, in, down, away）或介词短语放在句首，且主语是名词时，用完全倒装：谓语动词（不加助动词）+ 主语；主语是代词时不倒装：Here it comes.
eg: Here comes the bus!
公交车来了！
On the top of the hill stands an old temple.
山顶上矗立着一座古庙。
Out rushed the children when the bell rang.
铃一响，孩子们冲了出去。
q: In the middle of the square （ ）.
stands a statue of the poet
a statue of the poet stands it
does a statue of the poet stand
stand a statue of the poet

p: be bound / be likely / be liable to do
m: 必然会 / 很可能 / 容易（出现不好的情况）
use: be bound to do 表示“一定会，注定”；be likely to do 表示“很可能”；be liable / apt to do 表示“容易……”（多指不好的倾向）；be sure / certain to do 表示说话人认为“肯定会”。主语可以是人或物。
eg: With so much talent, she is bound to succeed.
她这么有才华，一定会成功。
The road is liable to flood after heavy rain.
大雨过后这条路容易被淹。
Prices are likely to rise next year.
明年物价很可能上涨。
q: If you keep driving that fast, you are （ ） to have an accident sooner or later.

p: 双重否定 not … without / never … but / not un-
m: 没有……就不……；（否定 + 否定 = 肯定）
use: 两个否定成分相互抵消，表示较强或委婉的肯定：not / never … without doing（每……必……），It never rains but it pours.（不雨则已，一雨倾盆），not unusual / not impossible（委婉地表示“挺常见 / 有可能”），nothing but（只是）。
eg: They never meet without arguing.
他们每次见面都要吵架。
It's not unusual for flights to be delayed in winter.
冬天航班延误并不少见。
There is no rule but has exceptions.
凡是规则都有例外。
q: My grandmother never visits us （ ） bringing homemade cakes.

p: 部分否定 not all / not every / not always
use: all, every, both, always, entirely, completely 等表示全部的词与 not 连用时，构成部分否定，意思是“并非都 / 并不总是”；表示全部否定要用 none, no one, neither, never 等。
eg: All that glitters is not gold. (= Not all that glitters is gold.)
闪光的未必都是金子。
Not every student likes maths.
并不是每个学生都喜欢数学。
The rich are not always happy.
有钱人并不总是快乐。
q: I agree with some of your points, but （ ） of them.

p: be about to do / be on the point of doing
use: be about to do 表示“马上就要做”，不与具体的将来时间状语连用，常与 when（这时）连用；be on the point of doing 意义相同，更正式。
eg: We were about to leave when it started to rain.
我们正要离开，这时开始下雨了。
The film is about to start. Turn off your phone.
电影快开始了，把手机关掉。
The company was on the point of closing down when a buyer appeared.
公司正要倒闭时出现了一个买家。
q: I was on the point of （ ） up when I finally found the answer.
